translations.web: “I myself most certainly thought that I ought to do many things contrary to the name of Jesus of Nazareth.
translations.bsb: So then, I too was convinced that I ought to do all I could to oppose the name of Jesus of Nazareth.
translations.kjv: I verily thought with myself, that I ought to do many things contrary to the name of Jesus of Nazareth.
